resources.string: Backup and merge
Current account UID
The current account has not been identified safely. Return to BeReal, refresh the feed and reopen this screen. Backup identity is never inferred from a post author.
Export saved post URLs and metadata as a SQLite file. Import a backup from another device using the same account to merge it into this device. Existing posts are not replaced wholesale.
Export SQLite backup
Import and merge backup
Associate unassigned old data

%1$d old or unassigned records have no viewer account identity. Their authors do not identify which account saved them. Associate them with account %2$s only after checking they belong to this account. Matching post IDs are merged; the original legacy table is retained locally.
Associate with this account

The file is not encrypted. It contains usernames, post dates, captions and full media URLs, including URL signatures. Do not share it publicly. Login passwords and authorization headers, media files, app settings and diagnostic logs are not included.
Choose destination

This transfers the local URL index, not photo/video files. A backup cannot renew expired URLs. URL alternatives and original observation dates are preserved. This is manual file-based merging, not automatic device sync.
